messages:
maria: Quick from rehearsal  main HDMI sometimes blacks out for 1-2s. If it happens live well fall back to spare laptop capture and a local mkv recording. Keep it simple.

sachin: Spare laptop + Elgato on Table A. Ill set OBS to fallback profile and mount SSD. Want me to mirror slides or just camera+slides as picture-in-picture?

jordan: PiP with slides priority. If we cut to spare, keep live stream on main until we confirm failure, switch recording source first.

maria: Ops steps: 1) mount SSD and pre-create folder /media/ssd/allhands-YYMMDD, 2) preload OBS scene "Allhands_Fallback_PiP", 3) capture at 10-bit if possible, 4) start recording ~2m before go.

austin: (ops) OBS fallback CLI:
```
obs-cli --profile AllhandsFallback --scene "Allhands_Fallback_PiP" --start-recording --output /media/ssd/allhands-$(date +%s).mkv
```
Also enable file integrity check after recording: md5sum /media/ssd/*.mkv > /media/ssd/checksums.txt

nick: Ill monitor network stats and have a hotspot ready. If encoder CPU spikes >85% shout here and we switch to local-only.

elaine: Q&A/run of show: Ill post the shared questions doc at T-10 and triage live. Please add an "asked_by" column. Ill tag Marta for leadership answers.

marta: Ill own leadership followups. For product/roadmap items tag #roadmap so PMs pick them up. For anything needing eng time tag @sachin.

caption-bot: Captions running en-US, streaming hook attached. If caption disconnects export VTT: Settings -> Export -> Download VTT. Keep manual copy in /media/ssd/captions/.

stream-bot: Reminder scheduled: T-5 will post stream health + captions status in this thread.

maria: Final go/no-go checklist at T-2: spare ready, SSD mounted, OBS fallback loaded, caption export path confirmed, Q&A doc link posted, escalation owner assigned. Ill post "ready" here.

sachin: SSD formatted ext4, folder created, doing a 30s record test now.

maria: Dry-run snippet: [09:58:12] obs: fallback profile loaded; [09:58:13] recorder: writing /media/ssd/allhands-1712345678.mkv; [09:58:45] recorder: stop; md5sum written.

jordan: Ill post doc link at T-10 and a Slack reminder at T-5. During live Q&A keep public answers short; detailed follow-ups via #allhands-followup.

marta: Also collect any partner/customer mentions so Sales can triage.

maria: If anything fails, shout here and well trigger the backup plan. Keep the runbook lean. :thumbsup:
